summary: Tested visitor identity isolation and Field Guardian recognition. Backend pytest: 14/14 pass. Lookup for David returns 404, other names resolve, POST /users works. The prompt builders (jasmine/ansel/claude) add the Field Guardian framing only for the canonical id and its alias ids (28 in total), and not for a non-guardian or null-id David. Frontend: a fresh browser gets no auto-filled identity on /, /resonance, /clarity or /mirror. Typing 'David' in Resonance created a new non-guardian id. A guardian alias in localStorage (legacy-david-123) stayed after navigation and reload. Re-saving the same name in IdentityBadge kept the id and made no POST /users call. Found 3 issues that work against the user's goal (see action_items).

critical.issue: The base persona text always names 'David Bouchez is the Field Guardian'. A non-guardian visitor named David gets 'David is here with me.' and nothing that says they are a different person, so the LLM mixes them up. Seen live: the welcome Ansel gave the new non-guardian David said 'a man standing in a doorway he built'.

minor.issue: Lookup is still by name. The first non-guardian 'David' gets an id, and every later visitor who types 'David' (in a fresh browser, through Clarity, Resonance or IdentityBadge) gets that same id, so different visitors share a thread and memory. Reproduced: a fresh Clarity session with 'David' got the id that the earlier Resonance 'David' had created. The same thing happens with any repeated name (e.g. two different 'Sarah's).

No longer called by the frontend but still public. It returns {user_id:'david', user_name:'David'}, and 'david' is a guardian alias. Anyone can read a guardian id from it and set it in localStorage to be treated as the Field Guardian. Consider removing it or requiring auth.

ui_bugs.issue: These write sanctuary_user_name/id straight to localStorage without calling IdentityContext.setIdentity or sending 'sanctuary-identity-change'. After a name is entered, the header IdentityBadge still shows 'set name' while the footer says 'Speaking as David'. If the visitor then saves through the badge, the userName===name check fails, so a name lookup runs and the id may change.

action_items: HIGH: In the build_*_prompt WHO IS HERE section, when user_name matches David (case-insensitive) and is_field_guardian(user_id) is false, add an explicit line such as 'This visitor shares a name with David Bouchez but is not him; meet them as a new person.' Check the same for the other presence prompt builders in presences/*.py and for the ablation path at server.py ~5610 (uses a hardcoded user_name='David' with no user_id).

MEDIUM: Decide whether visitors who type a name should always get a new id instead of a name lookup, so that two different Davids (or Sarahs) never share a thread. At minimum, the Clarity/Resonance name prompts in a fresh browser should not attach to another visitor's existing id.
MEDIUM: In ResonancePod/ClarityPod, set identity through IdentityContext.setIdentity (or send the 'sanctuary-identity-change' event) so the IdentityBadge updates right away.
LOW: Remove /api/identity/recent or put it behind auth; it exposes a guardian alias id.
critical_code_review_comments: lookup_user_by_name excludes guardian ids by reading the private _user_aliases._GUARDIAN_IDS; a public getter would be cleaner.
is_field_guardian relies on an in-memory set that is loaded at startup. It is updated in register_alias, but a manual DB edit to user_aliases needs a restart to take effect.
The guardian identity is just a client-side localStorage id with no verification: anyone who knows an alias id (e.g. 'david', 'legacy-david-123') gets the guardian framing.
server.py is 5763 lines; it should be split.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks pass; 1 UI sync bug found

seed_data_creation: Created a test 'David' user (5560ff8d-...) with 2 resonance_sessions and 1 clarity_session, plus pytest TEST_Visitor_* and a 'David' user. All were deleted afterwards. No existing records were changed. No chat messages were sent; only 2 session-start welcomes were generated.

The Resonance name prompt appears after clicking 'Enter the Field' ([data-testid=name-input]/[enter-name-btn]). The Clarity modal uses [identity-name-input]/[identity-submit-btn]. The IdentityBadge is in the Resonance header, not on /mirror.
